question_text: Match the process of reproduction and genetic exchange under column I with the explanation under column II. List I: A. Binary Fission, B. Transformation, C. Transduction, D. Conjugation. List II: I. Transfer of genetic material from the donor to recipient bacterium through cell contact, II. Common vegetative reproduction, III. Transfer of genetic material in bacteria through virus, IV. Horizontal gene transfer by taking up of foreign genetic material (naked DNA).
explanation: Binary fission corresponds to common vegetative reproduction (II), Transformation to uptake of naked DNA (IV), Transduction to transfer via virus (III), and Conjugation to transfer through cell contact (I).

question_text: Given below are two statements, one is labelled as Assertion A and the other is labelled as Reason R. Assertion A: Exotoxins diffuse freely through the bacterial cell wall into the medium in which the organisms are growing. Reason R: They are water soluble and can pass into the surrounding medium.

options.A: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
options.B: Both A and R are true but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
options.C: A is true but R is false
options.D: A is false but R is true

explanation: Exotoxins are soluble proteins secreted by bacteria, diffusing freely into the surrounding medium due to their water solubility.

question_text: Basic dyes are used in microbiological staining. Which of the following statement is wrong about mechanism of staining?

options.A: The positive ions on the surface of bacteria form a colored complex with the dye
options.B: Ionic exchange between the negative charge on the bacteria and positive charge of dye takes place
options.C: Ionic exchange between the positive charge on the bacteria and negative charge of dye takes place
options.D: The neutral charge on the surface of bacteria forms a colored complex with the basic dye

explanation: Basic dyes are positively charged (cationic) and bind to negatively charged bacterial surfaces, making option C factually incorrect regarding basic dyes.
